ambition: Build Frontier AI for Game Theory.
candidate_qualification: Exact feasible strategy interval width at most one part per million times max(1, maximum scenario sum of lane weights).
comparator_arms: restricted full normal-form HiGHS with exact double-oracle deviations
independent_acceptance: Evaluator separately froze a half-ppm interval-width threshold, an independently enumerated normal-form LP and exact deviations before candidate disclosure.
scope: Finite one-shot zero-sum allocation with optional private observation menu, exact rational channels, a cost per draw, and a scenario-aware opponent choosing before the draw.
stopping_rule: Report every frozen held case and all 30 development cases. Preserve time, resource, numerical, and verifier failures.
